section: LG displays available from AVI-SPL: Direct View LED, All-in-One DVLED and LG MAGNIT Micro LED
body:
LG is one of the visual collaboration technology manufacturers AVI-SPL partners with to supply AV and digital signage solutions. The LG page concentrates on commercial displays, mainly Direct View LED (DVLED), which matters when a customer is choosing a large display for a meeting room, lobby or other space.

**What to know**

- **LG in general.** LG B2B Solutions are described as flexible products that are easy to integrate and can be customized. LG digital signage is positioned as impactful, reliable and easy to manage, and the page names retail, restaurants, healthcare, education, hospitality and corporate environments as the settings it serves.
- **LG Direct View LED displays.** Features as stated:
  - Bezel-free screens that scale to any size.
  - High brightness and rich color reproduction, including in bright ambient lighting.
  - Multiple pixel pitches and a modular design, so the display can be built to fit the space, from meeting rooms to large feature walls.
  - Engineered for commercial use, with redundant systems available to minimize downtime.
  - Front serviceability and lightweight cabinets to simplify installation and maintenance.
  - Named settings: corporate lobbies, retail flagships and venues.
- **Ultimate Business Display.** An LG Direct View LED display offered in various sizes and performance levels, meant to remove the guesswork from configuration. Resolutions run from 2K to 8K, with 16:9 screen sizes from 81” to 325” (measured diagonally). It comes with all the components needed to deliver content.
- **All-in-One DVLED.** Aimed at a lobby, lecture hall or meeting room. It has an embedded controller and a built-in speaker, is described as easy to install, and everything needed for setup and maintenance is packed in a custom wheeled flight case.
- **LG MAGNIT Micro LED.** LG's Micro LED display technology, available from All-in-one to custom sizes. The page lists lobbies, conference rooms, auditoriums, control rooms, virtual production and home cinema among its uses.
- **Experts and ecosystem partners.** The page also offers a range of ecosystem partners for integrating hardware, software and services, on-site consultation with solution architects, plus service engineers and installation supervision, and teams experienced in commercial spaces.

**When to use this**

Use it when a customer asks which LG display types AVI-SPL can supply, what sizes and resolutions LG DVLED comes in, or which LG option suits a meeting room compared with a lobby or feature wall.

**Not stated in this source:** prices, pixel pitch values, and any video conferencing platform certification for these displays.
